name: stremio-web
one_liner: The web app for Stremio, a media center that lets you discover and watch movies, shows and channels through community-made add-ons instead of one fixed catalog.
buyer: Honestly this is a mature, already-monetized consumer product with its own addon ecosystem and official apps - the opportunity for a new, independent business is limited.
business_use_cases: An end user installs the web app to browse and watch content via addons across devices without installing native software.
An addon developer builds and monetizes a niche content addon, such as a regional sports catalog, for the existing Stremio user base.
A smart-TV or streaming-box reseller bundles Stremio Web as a pre-configured media center experience for customers.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a premium addon, such as a curated sports or regional content catalog, into the existing Stremio ecosystem rather than competing with the core app.

steal_this: This weekend, don't rebuild Stremio - instead build one well-made addon for an underserved niche catalog and publish it to the existing user base.
